name: veridu
description: Independent review of a code change before you commit, and of GitHub pull requests.

interface.longDescription:
Veridu reviews the change you or your agent just made. Ask it to verify a change: it sends the diff and the files it changed, two reviewers from different vendors check them, findings that cannot be grounded in the code are dropped, and you get back an outcome (pass, review or block) and concrete findings with file, line, severity and evidence. Only problems both reviewers confirm can block. Fix the findings that hold up and check again; each finding keeps the same id across follow-ups, so you can see what was fixed, what persists and what a fix introduced.

Veridu reviews only what is sent; it does not read the rest of your repository, so a pass means "nothing found in what was sent", not "safe to merge". For PHP it also traces callers and subclass overrides within the files sent.

You can also review a GitHub pull request by URL. Public repositories work right away; private ones once linked through the Veridu GitHub App.

Sign-in is in the browser with GitHub or Google; no API keys.
defaultPrompt: Verify the change I just made with Veridu before I commit.
Review this GitHub pull request with Veridu.
